                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在日常数据处理工作中，Excel的查找与替换是最频繁的操作之一。当数据量较大时，手动查找替换不仅耗时，还容易出错。本文将介绍如何使用 Python 和免费库 Free Spire.XLS for Python，以编程方式实现 Excel 数据的批量查找与替换，无需安装Microsoft Office。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过pip命令即可完成安装：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">pip install Spire.XLS.Free
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心对象模型</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">库的核心操作围绕两个对象展开：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Workbook</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：代表整个 Excel 工作簿，负责文件的加载与保存</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Worksheet</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：代表单个工作表，提供单元格访问与查找替换能力</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">导入方式：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">基本用法：在整个工作表中查找和替换</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">最基础的操作是在整个工作表中查找特定文本并将其替换为新内容。核心方法是</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Worksheet.FindAllString()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，它返回所有包含指定字符串的单元格。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以下示例演示了如何将工作表中所有的“总数”替换为“合计金额”，并高亮显示被修改的单元格：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建Workbook对象</span><br>
workbook = Workbook()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 加载Excel文件</span><br>
workbook.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据.xlsx"</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 获取第一个工作表</span><br>
worksheet = workbook.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 查找工作表中包含"总数"的所有单元格</span><br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 参数：要查找的字符串、是否区分大小写、是否完全匹配</span><br>
ranges = worksheet.FindAllString(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"总数"</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 遍历找到的单元格并替换</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> ranges:<br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>.Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"合计金额"</span><br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 设置背景色以突出显示被修改的单元格</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>.Style.Color = Color.get_Yellow()</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 保存结果文件</span><br>
workbook.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"替换结果.xlsx"</span>, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FindAllString()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">方法的三个参数分别表示：待查找的字符串、是否区分大小写（</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">True</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为区分）、是否要求完全匹配（</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">True</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为完全匹配）。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在指定单元格区域中查找和替换</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">当工作表数据量大时，限定搜索范围可以提高效率并避免误改。通过</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Worksheet.Range[]</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">获取特定区域后，使用</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">CellRange.FindAllString()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">方法在该区域内查找：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据.xlsx"</span>)</p>
<p>sheet = workbook.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 获取指定的单元格区域（A6到C13）</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span> = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"A6:C13"</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 在该区域内查找包含"总数"的单元格</span><br>
cells = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>.FindAllString(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"总数"</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> cell <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> cells:<br>
cell.Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"合计金额"</span><br>
cell.Style.Color = Color.get_Yellow()</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">workbook.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"区域替换结果.xlsx"</span>, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">高级技巧：查找后执行条件替换</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在实际场景中，替换逻辑可能不是简单的文本替换，而是需要根据条件进行判断。以下示例展示了如何在查找后根据单元格原有内容执行不同的替换逻辑：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"销售数据.xlsx"</span>)</p>
<p>worksheet = workbook.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 查找所有包含数字的单元格（假设需要将销售额单位从"元"改为"万元"）</span><br>
ranges = worksheet.FindAllString(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"元"</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>, <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">False</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> ranges:<br>
original = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>.Text<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 提取数字部分并转换为万元</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">try</span>:<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 假设原始格式为"1234元"</span><br>
num = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>(original.replace(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"元"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">""</span>))<br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>.Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"<span class="hljs-subst" style="color: rgba(55, 135, 199, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{num / <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">10000</span>:<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(118, 65, 187, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">.2</span>f}</span>万元"</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">except</span>:<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(103, 107, 121, 1); font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 如果格式不匹配，保持原样</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(217, 39, 146, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">pass</span></p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">workbook.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(13, 125, 108, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"条件替换结果.xlsx"</span>, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">结语</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 Python 编程实现 Excel 数据的查找与替换，可以将重复性的人工操作转化为自动化流程，尤其适用于定期更新的报表、大规模数据清洗等场景。上述示例覆盖了从整表替换到精确区域替换的多种需求，开发者可以根据实际业务场景灵活组合使用。</span></p></section>
